milestones.name: The Thorn Warden
lines: The Thorn Warden: I guarded tomorrow before your king put a price on it.
Aster: Watch its golden wind-up. Dash through the charge; jump over the ground-wave.

milestones.name: The Hour-Eater
lines: The Hour-Eater: Every second you steal will be paid in flame.
Aster: The cracks glow before it slams. Leap over the wave, then strike while it cools.

milestones.name: Veyr, the Hollow Regent
lines: Veyr: I took tomorrow so no one would have to say goodbye.
Lyra: You took every hello that had not happened yet.
Aster: When the crown lifts, falling light marks the ground. Move away, then return to strike.
